privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: An expired or rejected approval ends the step; cards respect quiet hours
goal: One card per approval-needing step, never at night
acceptance: A committed test fails first, unchanged by the fix: an expired or rejected memory.remember approval produces a second approval on the same sortie
After the fix the sortie ends (or waits for the owner) with one inbox line; no second approval is created
Approval cards honour the configured quiet hours like watch notices; a card due at night goes out at the end of the quiet window

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-16: one regression across ledger and sorties, a stop after expiry/reject, quiet-hours check in deliverApproval. Not a measurement.
